text:
elana: Heads-up: Customer Delta wants a private pilot. Core asks: reserved prewarm window, KMS/HSM key integration, canary rollout with automatic fallback to hosted API, 99.9% latency SLO. Need owners, blockers, and a realistic runway.

sam: I can take runtime work: prewarm orchestration, batching params, KV cache sizing. Quick question  what's expected peak QPS and token mix?

elana: Estimate: 150-250 qps during spikes, ~20k tokens/min. Traffic concentrated in business hours, some short bursts. Cold-start p99 target <150ms. I'll confirm numbers with the customer.

tess: Platform note: we can scaffold the deployment and rollout policy, but security must approve KMS/HSM exposure before we bring up the private control plane.

ravi: Security: KMS/HSM requires vendor paperwork + threat modelling. Expect ~10 business days for review after SOW + key access matrix. Also need IAM role definitions and ingress rules.

juan: Infra: we have two A100 nodes free in the May window, or 4x T4 as a cheaper option but higher p99. Which do you prefer? We can tentatively hold but need a commit date to convert to reserved capacity.

sam: Runtime prefers A100 for tight p99. T4 could work if we quantize aggressively, but expect ~25-35% higher p99 latency. If customer insists on <150ms p99, A100 reservation required.

elana: Model details: 7B SFT fp16 serving, KV cache ~3GB per shard, targeting 4 shards. Spec link: https://intra.redwood/specs/customer-delta (placeholder).

tess: Timeline: if security review starts Monday and infra holds slots this week, pilot is feasible in ~5 weeks. KMS gating is the critical path.

ravi: I'll start a pre-review today. Need SOW, network diagram, proposed KMS key policy, and a key rotation cadence.

sam: Runtime TODOs I'm tracking:
```
prewarm:
  target_qps: 200
  steady_duration_s: 900
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_latency_ms: 50
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  per_shard_gb: 3
```
I'll open PRs for the prewarm job and batching config; need infra endpoint + service principal.

juan: Action: tentatively holding 2x A100 from May12-May26 for the pilot. Confirm by EOD Friday to convert to hard reservation. Need final image tag and VPC CIDR.

deploy-bot: calendar: "Delta Pilot Kickoff" created for Thu 10:00  invites: @elana @sam @juan @tess @ravi.

elana: Recap action items:
1) elana  finalize customer spec + traffic numbers (by Wed).
2) juan  hold slots; confirm reservation EOD Fri.
3) ravi  run pre-review; request SOW + key policy (start today).
4) sam  open PRs for prewarm/batcher + request creds.
5) tess  schedule infra/runtime sync Thu 10am; include fallback plan to hosted API.
Call out blockers here if anything changes. :eyes: :thumbsup:

tess: Scheduling now; adding agenda (KMS gating, rollout steps, fallback policy, rollback criteria).

ravi: I'll add a security checklist to the ticket and share before the meeting.

sam: I'll prototype prewarm locally and post early perf numbers in the thread before Thu.

elana: Thanks all  I'll update the roadmap entry and notify the customer of tentative runway.

tess: One more ask: product wants clear launch criteria: perf verification (p99 <150ms), security signoff, and validated rollback to hosted with no data leakage. Agree?

ravi: Agreed. Also require end-to-end encryption verification and monitoring hooks for key use.

juan: Also note cost estimate: A100 reserved pilot ~2x node-weeks; ops will need cost signoff from finance if they go beyond the pilot window.

elana: I'll coordinate finance sign-off after we confirm infra reservation.

sam: OK, will add telemetry events and a perf smoke test that can run in CI against the pilot infra.

elana: If anything blocks KMS, fallback path is to serve via hosted model with tenant isolation; make sure RBAC and logging meet their compliance needs.

tess: Copy that  will document fallback steps and alert routing in the runbook.
